title.ja: 年内にやるべきPERSESおすすめの3つのこと！
title.en: 3 recommended things to do with PERSES before the end of the year!
title.ko: 올해가 지나기 전에 해야 할 PERSES 추천 3가지!
title.zh-TW: 今年年底前必做的 PERSES 推薦 3 件事！
title.id: 3 hal yang direkomendasikan PERSES untuk dilakukan sebelum akhir tahun!
title.pt: 3 coisas recomendadas pelo PERSES para fazer antes do ano acabar!

summary.ja: クリッティンとパームが年内にやるべきこととして、PERSESを好きになること、曲を聴くこと、ライブに行くことの3つを告知を交えて紹介します。
summary.en: Krittin and Palm introduce three things to do before the end of the year: falling in love with PERSES, listening to their music, and going to their concert, along with an announcement.
summary.ko: 크릿틴과 팜이 올해 안에 해야 할 일로 PERSES 입덕하기, 노래 듣기, 콘서트 가기의 3가지를 공지와 함께 소개합니다.
summary.zh-TW: Krittin 與 Palm 結合宣傳活動，介紹了今年底前必做的 3 件事：愛上 PERSES、聽他們的歌，以及去看他們的演唱會。
summary.id: Krittin dan Palm menyampaikan tiga hal yang harus dilakukan sebelum akhir tahun bersamaan dengan pengumuman: menyukai PERSES, mendengarkan lagu mereka, dan pergi ke konser mereka.
summary.pt: Krittin e Palm apresentam três coisas para fazer antes do ano acabar: se apaixonar pelo PERSES, ouvir suas músicas e ir ao show deles, junto com um anúncio.

caption.th:
3 สิ่งที่ควรทำก่อนจบปีนี้!
1. ชอบเพอเซส (ดิเพล)
2. ฟังเพลงเพอเซส (ดิเพล)
3. ไปคอนเสิร์ตเพอเซส (ดิเพล)
ใครไม่ไปจะตามไปหลอกให้หมด!
caption.ja:
今年が終わる前にやるべき3つのこと！
1. PERSESを好きになること
2. PERSESの曲を聴くこと
3. PERSESのコンサートに行くこと
来ない人は全員化けて出てやる！
caption.en:
3 things to do before this year ends!
1. Like PERSES (Diplay)
2. Listen to PERSES songs (Diplay)
3. Go to a PERSES concert (Diplay)
Anyone who doesn't go, we will follow and haunt you all!
caption.ko:
올해가 끝나기 전에 해야 할 3가지!
1. PERSES 좋아하기 (디플레이)
2. PERSES 노래 듣기 (디플레이)
3. PERSES 콘서트 가기 (디플레이)
안 오는 사람은 끝까지 쫓아가서 괴롭힐 거야!
caption.zh-TW:
今年結束前必做的3件事！
1. 喜歡 PERSES (Diplay)
2. 聽 PERSES 的歌 (Diplay)
3. 去看 PERSES 的演唱會 (Diplay)
誰如果不去，我們就追去嚇死你們！
caption.id:
3 hal yang harus dilakukan sebelum tahun ini berakhir!
1. Suka PERSES (Diplay)
2. Dengarkan lagu PERSES (Diplay)
3. Pergi ke konser PERSES (Diplay)
Siapa yang tidak pergi akan kami hantui semuanya!
caption.pt:
3 coisas para fazer antes deste ano acabar!
1. Gostar do PERSES (Diplay)
2. Ouvir músicas do PERSES (Diplay)
3. Ir ao show do PERSES (Diplay)
Quem não for, nós vamos atrás para assombrar todos vocês!
